findings.title: Rapid double-save can corrupt an in-progress draft
findings.description: editor/autosave.ts:52 — two autosaves firing within the same debounce window race on the same draft file with no lock, occasionally interleaving partial writes.
findings.suggested_action: Bound the acceptable cost of this, or serialize writes per draft.

findings.title: Save handler dereferences an optional field without a null check
findings.description: editor/autosave.ts:61 reads `req.body.clientMeta.deviceId` but `clientMeta` is optional per the request schema and can be absent, throwing on any client that omits it.
findings.suggested_action: Add a guard before dereferencing clientMeta.

findings.title: Approve endpoint can double-merge on a network-retried request
findings.description: editor/approve.ts:41 — a client retry after a timed-out response re-runs the full merge with no de-duplication, so the same approval can apply twice if the first response was lost in transit.
findings.suggested_action: De-duplicate retried approvals so a lost response can't cause a double-merge.

findings.title: No deterministic way to detect the autosave race after the fact
findings.description: editor/autosave.ts:52 — even with the race above bounded, there's currently no way to tell, from stored data alone, that two saves actually raced versus one simply arriving late.
findings.suggested_action: Consider a way to make racing saves detectable, not just less harmful.
